dedupe_keys.name: 和歌山県 福祉のまちつくりマッフ掲載公共施設一覧 evacuation shelters and public facilities

description: 【和歌山県】福祉のまちづくりマップ掲載公共施設一覧 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 和歌山県. 県内の障害者、高齢者等が安全かつ円滑に利用できるよう配慮された施設（官公庁舎、文化施設、医療施設、大規模小売店舗、金融機関・郵便局、宿泊施設、鉄道駅）の概要、整備状況（車椅子対応設備やオストメイト設備の有無）、位置など、身体の不自由な方々が街に出かける際に参考になる情報を掲載しています。. Coverage: 和歌山県. The portal files it under the publisher 和歌山県. Its tags are まちづくり, バリアフリー, バリアフリーマップ, マップ, 位置情報. It offers 37 resource(s) in csv, geojson, html, kml, zip. The portal shows 2022-10-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
